limitations.detail: The intended two-level unitary swaps |01> and |10> and preserves |00> and |11>. Human fixed.py instead implements CX(q1,q0), exchanging |10> and |11>. Uniform initial amplitudes conceal this defect; the oracle checks the full post-initialization operator. Both sources are rejected.

Both implementations produce valid low-energy results in listed Qiskit0.46.3. The source question concerns migration to Qiskit1.x; old APIs are still available in0.46.3. The test intentionally accepts correct legacy computation rather than manufacture an API-style failure.

oracle_notes.detail: The fixed source batches ten successful unmeasured Grover circuits. The batching oracle checks job/experiment counts without requiring a classical readout that the question never requested.
theta=1/3 accidentally masks the bit reversal for three counting qubits. The test also calls the exported qft_dagger on a fresh3-qubit circuit and checks its complete inverse Fourier operator.
Contrary to the spreadsheet note, vars(circ.data) is valid in Qiskit0.25.0 because QuantumCircuitData has a __dict__. Fixed passes and buggy fails the instruction-data-output oracle.

Uses public Aqua op_converter.to_matrix_operator to read WeightedPauliOperator. Checks preservation of the source-chosen3x3 matrix after zero-padding, permitting the different constants in the existing pair.

Ideal Aer gives Delay no drift and makes both scripts succeed. The oracle evaluates the exported sequence under three explicit static-phase drift rates, retaining its real gate actions and interpreting each delay as physical phase accumulation.

sandbox_note: Initial sandbox runs could not register existing SciPy DLL directories. Final logs are from the approved identical local validation command outside the sandbox; no dependencies were installed or modified.
